label: Product demo

kinds.hero: Opening shot: the product name with its pack image, or the product as a turning 3D model.
kinds.stat: A benefit told as a number, with the morphing icon.
kinds.benefit: A benefit told in words, with the morphing icon.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.

fields.asset: The product pack image. Not shown when a 3D model is set.
fields.model: A 3D model of the product (.glb, glTF 2.0 binary) from the project assets, turning in the pack window instead of the pack image.
fields.spin: How the 3D model moves: turn (default) turns it on its axis; orbit circles the camera round it; hero sways it while the camera eases in; reveal rises and grows in, then turns; detail pushes the camera in for a close-up.
fields.kicker: A short label for the benefit, e.g. "Absorbency".
fields.cta.icon: The icon the closing card ends on; it morphs from the last benefit.

description: Introduces a product in 10 to 60 seconds: a hero with the product pack or a turning 3D model, two to five benefits (stat or icon), then a call to action. One SVG icon morphs through every benefit and carries into the CTA. Landscape puts the pack beside the text; portrait and square stack them.
